title: Nice red color
text: Nice red color. These are not plush if thats what you were looking for. They are a flat material. The backing keeps the rugs in place but they do have a tendancy to move around a little. I like that they are not thin and flimsy. I put them in my laundry room. The smaller one we put our shoes on. I do like both of these rugs.

product_metadata.title: ITSOFT 2pc Natural Rubber Backing Non-Slip Kitchen Rug Set Indoor Outdoor Doormat Runner Rug Set, 17.5 x 27.5 Inches + 17.5 x 55 Inches, Red
features: Material: The upper part is polyester flocking cloth, soft to touch, ease for feet to walk on it. Non-skid rubber backing ensure safety, fade and wear resistant.

Non-slip: Skid-resistant bottom is made of high quality rubber material. This backing helps keeping the mat firmly in place, that it won't slip or slide keeping you more safe and cozy. Place rug on dry smooth floor only.
Great Absorbency: Constructed to absorb water and dry quickly, give you a clean and fresh room and protect the floor from water damage.
Decoration: Lightweight and low profile to be placed in any setting, suitable for kid's room, doorway, indoor outdoor, kitchen floor, foyer, bedroom, balcony, porch, dining room.
Easy Care: Wash with mild detergent in cold water, hang to dry or air dry flat. The material will not shrink or turn rough after the wash, keeping your rug in the same shape as the day you bought it.
description: This kitchen rug is designed for water absorption, keep your kitchen dry and moisture. Slip resistant: rubbery backing is designed to ensure you have a safe activity. While an important safety precaution to prevent accidental slippage of your rugs, you might be surprised to learn it can actually help protect the flooring beneath it. Low pile runner avoiding any bulk on your floor and allowing doors to open easily without snagging under swinging doors. Fashion design adds a touch of decoration to your kitchen. An item suitable for kid's playroom, dining rooms, porch kitchen, bathroom, entryway, living room.
